name: Tabs
description: A frame under the title with a few tabs, each holding one panel (a list, a table or a paragraph); tabs switch during playback, static output shows only the first. Three slides would lose the comparison of switching inside one frame.

title.hint: a one-line claim, up to 24 characters

panels.hint: 2 to 5 tabs, labels up to 6 characters; a panel holds 3 to 5 items or a small table; the first panel is what static output and QA see

caption.hint: one line of source or reminder

brand.value: Confirm the story before the slides

title.value: One flow, three roles, three views

items: Write the story file first, one message per slide
Layouts are generated only after sign-off
Edit wording in the browser, never go back to the layout
Read the per-slide summary and rhythm bar, not the layout
Reply "confirmed" or name the slides to change
Confirm again after any change, however small

caption.value: Tabs switch during playback; static mode shows only the first panel.
